compliance_decision:
1. Acceptable documents may include government-issued photo identification, utility bills with contact details and address matching the customer's residence, or a passport for international customers when verifying identity as per regulatory guidance on Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures in [2019.03-Guidance-Guidance-Note-4B-STRs.txt].
2. Relevant Regulatory Basis: 2019.03-Guidance-Guidance-Note-4B-STRs.txt, Chunk 532 (Know Your Customer procedures)
3. Explanation: The regulatory guidance suggests that for customer identity verification under KYC requirements, acceptable documents should include government-issued photo identification or utility bills with matching contact details and address to the customer's residence as alternatives when personal ID is not available; however, foreign IDs are only considered if they can be checked.
